_doc: Real names for Night City's people (Names.person / Names.full_name). cultures.<id>: name, weight (share of Night City's people, HOUSE-RULE), countries (the Wikidata citizenships drawn on), given.{masc,femme,neutral} and family (family_masc / family_femme where the culture's surnames are gendered), each list most common first. family_mix: chance a person's family name comes from another culture. given_mix: which given-name lists each gender draws from. Generated by tools/gen_names_data.py: rerun it rather than editing by hand.

_provenance.wikidata: Given names (P735) and family names (P734) of people by citizenship (P27), counted per name, with each name item's English label and type (male, female or unisex given name), where the query service allowed; and given-name and family-name items by language (P407), most linked first (search sorted by incoming links), for every culture. Wikidata, CC0 1.0 (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing). Queried 2026-11.
_provenance.sigpwned: Popular names by country (https://github.com/sigpwned/popular-names-by-country-dataset), CC0 1.0: the top given names by sex and the commonest surnames per country, compiled in 2023 from Wikipedia's lists of most popular given names and most common surnames (name lists: facts, not creative text). Interleaved with Wikidata's order so recent popular names show up beside long-standing ones.
_provenance.us_census_2010: Frequently Occurring Surnames from the 2010 Census (US Census Bureau), with the share by race and Hispanic origin: the Anglo culture takes surnames mostly held by White or Black Americans, the Latino culture those mostly held by Hispanic Americans. Public domain (a work of the US federal government, 17 U.S.C. 105). https://www2.census.gov/topics/genealogy/2010surnames/names.zip
_provenance.composed: Chinese given names beyond the sourced ones are built from authored lists of common pinyin syllables (COMPOSE in the tool).
_provenance.curation: tools/gen_names_data.py: Latin-script labels only (accents the game's fonts lack are folded), filtered by data/gen/name_filter.json, lists cut to the most common names. Cultures, weights and the mixing rate are HOUSE-RULE for Night City 2045. The name tables of Cyberpunk RED: Single Player Mode (SPM p.52-54) were a style guide only; none of their lists are copied.
